_readme: S720 (lever), the gap census's reader_page_assignment lever (run 45319725062): 3 programs of Santiago Canyon College whose filed record places none of the state's listed courses and for which no page of the 2026-27 catalog holds a section a read could place them from. Free page read 45341735139 printed every page of the catalog PDF the capture reads; the college's other programs on the lever are pinned in its reconcile entry (kb/program_requirements_reconcile.json, pdf_pages). These are filed as named gaps and are never sent to a paid read. Their filed records stay as filed (the load skips a record that places none). No model call, no Supabase write. They are the college's to settle in COCI.

reasons.catalog_list_differs: The 2026-27 catalog prints the program's own section and course list, and the list names fewer than half of the state's listed courses: the Program Course File's list and the catalog's differ, so a read of the section would place too few of them to count.
reasons.ge_pattern_certificate: General-education pattern certificate. It has no fixed course list by design (the census's named gap, kb/_harvest_gap_census.py NAMED_GAPS).

programs.title: CSU General Education Breadth
programs.award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 30S/45Q to fewer than 60S/90Q units
programs.note: The state lists 272 courses; 'Control Number: 18117' closes 'California State University General Education Breadth (CSU), CA' on PDF p.102, which names its pattern (Plan B, 39 units) and prints no course list.

programs.title: IGETC
programs.award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 30S/45Q to fewer than 60S/90Q units
programs.note: The state lists 197 courses; 'Control Number: 18118' closes 'Intersegmental General Education Transfer Curriculum (IGETC), CA' on PDF p.102, which names its pattern (Plan C, 34 units) and prints no course list.

programs.title: Code Enforcement and Compliance
programs.note: 'Control Number: 37073' closes 'Code Enforcement and Compliance, AS' on PDF p.130, whose list prints CJ101, PBLC085, PBLC150, PBLC050, 061 and 151 to 155: 6 of the 17 the state lists (BUS 90, CIS 101, the four COMM courses, MGMT 122, PBLC 80, the two POLS C1000 and RE 103 print nowhere in it).
